title: AI-Assisted Hypothesis Generation for Hospital Quality Improvement
abstract: arXiv:2604.20055v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Hospital quality improvement (QI) programs generally proceed in two stages: (1) hypothesis generation, which identifies candidate factors that may improve care quality and efficiency, and (2) confirmatory analyses, which implement and evaluate QI initiatives targeting these factors. Although most research focuses on the confirmatory stage, hypothesis generation is equally important because it shapes where teams focus their effort. translated_title: 医院质量改进中的AI辅助假设生成
translated_abstract: 医院质量改进（QI）项目通常分为两个阶段：（1）假设生成，即识别可能提升医疗质量与效率的候选因素；（2）验证性分析，即针对这些因素实施并评估相应的质量改进举措。尽管大多数研究聚焦于验证性阶段，但假设生成同样重要，因为它决定了团队努力的聚焦方向。目前，假设生成依赖于专家驱动的定性方法（例如精益医疗工具），这些方法往往流于轶事性、难以复现、耗时且资源密集。大语言模型（LLM）可以通过大规模分析临床笔记来加速这一过程，但现有AI工具只能很好地扩展界定明确的任务，而假设生成是一个“模糊”、探索性且迭代的过程。我们提出不仅将LLM指令，而且将问题规范和……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 该论文提出利用大语言模型加速医院质量改进中传统上依赖专家定性方法的假设生成阶段，并主张将问题规范本身也作为可迭代调整的对象，以应对这一“模糊”且探索性的任务。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes using large language models to accelerate the hypothesis generation stage of hospital quality improvement—traditionally reliant on expert-driven, qualitative methods—by treating not only LLM instructions but also the problem specification as iteratively adjustable, thereby handling this "fuzzy," exploratory, and iterative process.
